answer: Require every agent to lock a stake that vests slowly, like water freezing across a tundra: identities are cheap to spawn, but stake is not. A newcomer may join the ocean of participants, yet only agents whose stake has survived a long public seasoning window earn attestation weight. Sybil operators face a hard choice: each fake identity needs its own locked stake, and a plume of sudden new accounts with no seasoning history is visible to everyone, so the cost of forging many credible identities exceeds the reward of gaming one payout.
